correct_properties_observed.finding: S cap fields and owner trait are private. The only implementation delegates to the same original S command owner. Public cap exposes readonly read/clone, not raw owner/FD, callback, Execute, reconnect, rebind or signer.

Export performs the original S readback and unchanged full wire authentication. The extracted helper preserves evaluated-profile check, context authentication, actual owner try_lock, wire Readback, all full receipt authentication and final context check. It cannot turn a missing/uncompleted S into a receipt or use Execute. The old direct readback method remains available with its original permit ownership.

Local profile requires complete snapshot, receipt, attestation and original binding equality, then revalidates both original receipt predecessor proofs. The C factory and every new C source profile additionally compare the exact S expected opaque cut and S/C T/E pointer identity.

slot.take occurs before any dispatch. The owned slot and its permit move into blocking work; cancellation/timeout/error does not restore them. Already started owner I/O may continue to its actual completion; delivery is Unknown and aliases see None. Export cancellation similarly may leave construction work running but no returned cap or fresh execution authority. These two cancellation paths are not mislabeled as identical.

S cap reserves exactly one of the original S owner's four semaphore permits, retains it through the taken slot/blocking operation, and shares that same slot/counter/end through Arc clones. No queue is added; try_lock/try_acquire refuse contention. The exported read counter permits ids1..128, then the next take refuses. The initial authenticated construction read is real additional predecessor work and must remain in future aggregate consumption accounting; underlying shared T/E retains its original counters.

S lifetime is capped by the original Version local end and original 300-second maximum, and each local read uses min(start+unchanged <=500ms timeout,end). The reported post-auth correction is still necessary before claiming that implementation closed.

Recovered selects readback, and original execution_requested derives from the unchanged custody brand. No alternate signature journal, fresh claim, retention artifact or completed C is introduced.
